description: One part of a session, as the digest prompt asks for it (BUILD-PLAN M2.6).

summary.description: One to four sentences on what happened.

handoff.description: What a session that resumes this one needs to know to start.

in_flight.description: What was being worked on when this part ended, and the entry it comes from; empty text and entry when nothing was.

entry.description: The label of the entry it comes from, such as #3.

failed.description: Approaches tried that did not work.

entry.description: The label of the entry it comes from, such as #3.

open.description: Questions and next steps left open.

entry.description: The label of the entry it comes from, such as #3.

facts.description: What a future session could not learn from the code or the git history.

statement.description: One sentence, in plain present tense, that stands on its own, calling the user "the user", never by name or pronoun.

kind.description: The kind of fact, as design 6 names them.

source.description: Where the fact came from; a tentative remark is suggested, never stated.

term.description: Long if still true and useful a year from now; short if it will change as the work moves on.

quote.description: Words copied from one entry, which the script finds in that entry or drops the fact.

entry.description: The label of the entry the quote comes from, such as #3.

scope.description: Global for the user's preferences and environment; project for everything else.
